businesses.business: healthcare information technology software and services

offering_description.value: Sells electronic health records, revenue cycle management and patient engagement software and related services to rural and community hospitals and health systems in the United States. It delivers them mainly as hosted software on subscription, plus outsourced billing and collections work.

primary_products.value: electronic health records software; revenue cycle software; patient engagement software

primary_services.value: revenue cycle management outsourcing; hosting and managed IT; implementation and training; customer support

customer_segment.value: B2B: rural and community hospitals, critical access hospitals, health systems

revenue_model.value: subscription: hosted software licenses for hospitals; transaction or usage fees: revenue cycle fees tied to billing and collections volume; service fees: implementation, support and managed IT services
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: hospital software and hosted systems, sold to hospitals; service provider: outsourced billing and revenue cycle work for hospitals

geography_served.value: US national: hospitals across many US states, concentrated in rural areas

specialization.value: related lines: EHR software, revenue cycle services and patient engagement tools sold to the same hospital customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling directly to hospital executives and finance staff

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: EHR certification rules and HIPAA patient data privacy rules apply to its software and billing work

notes: Company size and offering details are based on general knowledge and may have changed.
